cells.label: ironRam
cells.note: TIN. It is the only enemy immune to foam darts, and the shiny soup tin — with darts stuck uselessly to it — is the whole of how the player is told. Never cardboard or plastic.

sheets.title: Toy Knight and projectiles
sheets.brief: The Toy Knight ally plus every projectile kind. Only the foam dart and the toothpick can be bitmaps; the rest are reference.

cells.label: cavalry
cells.note: Reference only — the rider is adopted as a GALLOP STRIP from walk-cavalry, not as a still. Cool blue, gold pennant, facing right. Must stay unmistakable against the warm-toned enemies at a glance.

cells.label: foam dart
cells.note: The most-fired round in the game — the dart blaster, the paper boat and the rubber duck.

cells.label: toothpick
cells.note: The rubber-band crossbow’s round, and the one shot the player has to see coming and answer.

cells.label: water blob
cells.note: Squirt-gun water blob (hostile: catapult pebble / sand clod). No override hook: this one is drawn from its own geometry every frame.

cells.label: mud ball
cells.note: Mud-mortar mud ball (balloon launcher: water balloon, knot trailing). No override hook: this one is drawn from its own geometry every frame.

cells.label: honey bomb
cells.note: Bumblebee honey bomb — drips hang straight down. No override hook: this one is drawn from its own geometry every frame.

cells.label: ember
cells.note: Firefly ember, tumbling under its own flame. No override hook: this one is drawn from its own geometry every frame.

cells.label: ice shard
cells.note: The frost round is a live particle emitter; this is only its core shard.

sheets.title: Flowers, sky bodies and shipped UI
sheets.brief: The discrete background objects and the two bitmaps that already ship. The tileable parallax bands are deliberately absent — they need a strip, not a grid.

cells.label: conifer
cells.note: The slot is still called conifer; it is the TALL flower of the bed now (a sunflower, sometimes a hollyhock). Reads at about 5–9% of the screen height, so silhouette over detail.

cells.label: broadleaf
cells.note: The slot is still called broadleaf; it is the LOW flower clump of the bed now (tulips, daisies, dandelions or clover). Must not read as the tall flower at distance.

cells.label: sun
cells.note: Disc plus its ray fan. The wide bloom wash across the sky and the dawn/day/dusk tinting are painted around this, not into it, so they stay procedural.

cells.label: moon
cells.note: Cream disc with a sleeping face, no rays. Identical at every wave tier — the storm sunset on a boss wave is the SKY changing behind it, not the moon itself.

cells.label: coin
cells.note: Already a bitmap. Letterboxed into the cell here — check its real aspect ratio in the index before overwriting it.

cells.label: logo
cells.note: Already a bitmap. Letterboxed into the cell here — check its real aspect ratio in the index before overwriting it.
